# Supported Wake Word Models

<!-- Generated by tool/generate_wakeword_list.py. Do not edit manually. -->

This file lists all WakeNet models bundled with ESP-SR. The model files are stored in [`model/wakenet_model`](model/wakenet_model/).

> **Note:** Most wake word models are automatically generated and tested using the TTS pipeline. Their generalization performance cannot be fully guaranteed. Evaluate each model thoroughly in its intended environment before commercial use.

## Loading a Wake Word Model

There are two ways to load a wake word model:

1. **Load models from an external path.** Run `idf.py menuconfig`, open `ESP Speech Recognition`, and set `Load models from external path` (`ESP_SR_EXTERNAL_MODEL_PATH`) to a directory containing one or more model folders. This directory can be located anywhere on the build host. Each model folder must contain a valid `_MODEL_INFO_` file and the required model data. During the build, CMake automatically packages all valid models found at this path into the model partition.
2. **Add a menuconfig entry for a model bundled with ESP-SR.** The model folder must be placed under `esp-sr/model/wakenet_model`. Add a `bool` entry to the appropriate `Load Multiple Wake Words` menu in `Kconfig.projbuild`. Name the symbol `SR_WN_<MODEL_FOLDER_NAME_IN_UPPERCASE>` so that it maps to the folder name. For example, the folder `wn9_my_wake_word` must use `SR_WN_WN9_MY_WAKE_WORD`. Select the new entry in menuconfig and rebuild the application; CMake will package the selected model automatically.
